## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes and generated artifacts are included.

## Data and scope

- [ ] Examples are synthetic; no credentials, real HARs or personal data.
- [ ] Local processing and redaction limitations are preserved.
- [ ] Unrelated changes are excluded.
